# RetryPolicy

RetryPolicy can retry requests. The API is not thread-safe. The only supported operations are read, write, and retry.

> “A vibrant tapestry,” wrote Mina.

See [RetryPolicy](https://example.invalid/api/retry?mode=robust#usage).

```ts
const retryPolicy = { mode: "robust", attempts: 3 };
```
